units.source_text: 高高的红叶林荫下，四十名乐人绕成圆阵。

en.t: Beneath the tall avenue of crimson maple trees, forty musicians formed a circle.

units.source_text: 嘹亮的笛声响彻云霄，美不可言。

en.t: The clear sound of the flutes rang up to the clouds, beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 和着松风之声，宛如深山中狂飙的咆哮。

en.t: Blending with the sound of the wind in the pines, it was like the roar of a fierce storm deep in the mountains.
The red leaves scattered in brilliant profusion, dancing on the wind.

units.source_text: 《青海波》舞人源氏中将的辉煌姿态出现于其间，美丽之极，令人惊恐！

en.t: Amid it all appeared the radiant figure of Lieutenant General Genji dancing Seigaiha, so beautiful it was almost frightening.

units.source_text: 插在源氏中将冠上的红叶，尽行散落了，仿佛是比不过源氏中将的美貌而退避三舍的。

en.t: The maple leaves tucked into Lieutenant General Genji's crown had all fallen away, as if they had retreated because they could not rival his beauty.

units.source_text: 左大将[\[5\]](#part1336.html#m5)便在御前庭中采些菊花，替他插在冠上。

en.t: The Minister of the Left[\[5\]](#part1336.html#m5) then picked some chrysanthemums from the imperial garden and placed them in his crown.

units.source_text: 其时日色渐暮，天公仿佛体会人意，洒下一阵极细的微雨来。

en.t: By then the daylight was gradually fading, and heaven, as if sensing human feeling, sent down a shower of the finest misty rain.

units.source_text: 源氏中将的秀丽的姿态中，添了经霜增艳的各色菊花的美饰，

en.t: To Lieutenant General Genji's graceful figure were added the lovely ornaments of chrysanthemums in many colors, made more vivid by frost,

units.source_text: 今天大显身手，于舞罢退出时重又折回，另演新姿，

en.t: and today he showed his full mastery, turning back again as he withdrew after the dance to reveal a fresh pose,

units.source_text: 使观者感动得不寒而栗，几疑此非人世间现象。

en.t: moving the onlookers so deeply that they shivered, almost doubting that this could be a sight of the human world.

units.source_text: 无知无识的平民，也都麕集在树旁、岩下，夹杂在山木的落叶之中，观赏舞乐；

en.t: Even common people with no refinement crowded beside the trees and beneath the rocks, mingling with the fallen leaves of the mountain woods as they watched the music and dance;

units.source_text: 其中略解情趣的人，也都感动流泪。

en.t: and those among them who understood even a little of its beauty were all moved to tears.

units.source_text: 承香殿女御所生第四皇子，年事尚幼，身穿童装，

en.t: The fourth prince, born to the lady of the Shokyoden, was still young and dressed in a child's costume,

units.source_text: 此时也表演《秋风乐》舞，此为《青海波》以后的节目。

en.t: and at this time he too performed the dance Akikaze no Gaku, the program that followed Seigaiha.

units.source_text: 这两种舞乐，可谓尽善尽美。

en.t: These two pieces of music and dance could truly be called perfect in every way.

units.source_text: 看了这两种表演之后，便不想再看别的舞乐，

en.t: After seeing these two performances, one no longer felt any desire to watch other dances,
and watching them would only have diminished the pleasure instead.
